[[Charleston Classic]] champions |tourney=[[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result=Sweet Sixteen }} {{2023–24 Big 12 men's basketball standings}} The '''2023–24 Houston Cougars men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Houston]] in the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cougars were led by tenth-year head coach [[Kelvin Sampson]]. The team played their home games at the [[Fertitta Center]] as first-year members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. Houston finished the regular season 28–3, 15–3 in conference play, and were regular-season champions of the Big 12 in their first year in the conference. In the [[2024 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]], Houston defeated [[2023–24 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] and [[2023–24 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] before losing to [[2023–24 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the championship game. They received an at-large bid to the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the #1 seed in the South Regional. They defeated [[2023–24 Longwood Lancers men's basketball team|Longwood]] in the first round and [[2023–24 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in overtime in the second round to advance to their fifth consecutive Sweet Sixteen appearance. There, they were defeated by [[2023–24 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] after losing their starting point guard, [[Jamal Shead]], to an ankle sprain during the game. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Cougars]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 29–2, 17–1 in [[2022–23 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to win the AAC regular season championship. They defeated [[2022–23 East Carolina Pirates men's basketball team|East Carolina]] and [[2022–23 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]] to advance to the [[2023 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] championship game where they lost to [[2022–23 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the #1 seed in the Midwest Regional. They defeated [[2022–23 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team|Northern Kentucky]] and [[2022–23 Auburn Tigers men's basketball team|Auburn]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen for the fourth consecutive year. There they lost to [[2022–23 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami (FL)]]. On November 28, 2022, the team reached the number one ranking in the AP Poll, marking the first time they had held the top spot since [[1982–83 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|1983]]. The season marked Houston's last as a member of the AAC.
